ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic longitudinal profile of some sections of the Yangtze River and the Yellow River; the vertical axis represents height ratio, and the horizontal axis represents ratio of distance from the river mouth; the Yellow River longitudinal profile curve is marked with place names such as “a certain place in Ningxia” and “Baotou.” Near “a certain place in Ningxia” to “Baotou,” the Yellow River curve is relatively the flattest, indicating that this river section has a small longitudinal gradient. Then reason: A small slope on the river longitudinal profile corresponds to a slower water flow speed; at the same time, the Ningxia to Baotou area belongs to a Yellow River section in the north with an ice period, and the river has the characteristic of flowing toward higher latitudes, so ice floods are likely to occur. Therefore, the river section that meets “slow water flow and prone to ice-flood phenomena” is the Ningxia to Baotou river section.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：识别黄河纵剖面曲线及地名标注，找出曲线最平缓的黄河河段，读出为宁夏某地到包头附近。再根据题干要求“水流缓慢”对应纵剖面坡度小，结合地理常识“北方河段有结冰期且向高纬流动易发生凌汛”，判断该平缓且易凌汛的河段为宁夏至包头河段。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是长江、黄河部分河段的纵剖面示意，纵轴表示高度比率，横轴表示距河口比率；黄河纵剖面曲线上标有“宁夏某地”“包头”等地名。在“宁夏某地”到“包头”附近，黄河曲线相对最平缓，说明该河段纵比降小。再推理：河流纵剖面坡度小，对应水流速度较慢；同时宁夏至包头一带属于北方有结冰期的黄河河段，且河流有向较高纬度流动的特点，容易发生凌汛。因此符合“水流缓慢，且易出现凌汛现象”的河段是宁夏至包头河段。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 河流纵剖面中坡度越小，水流越缓；凌汛多发生在有结冰期且由较低纬流向较高纬的河段，黄河宁夏至包头段位于北方并有向北流特征，容易发生冰坝壅水。
